Gold.note: Central bank buying and macro hedging sustain bullish momentum despite elevated spot levels.

Silver.note: Strong industrial demand from solar and gold correlation support upside despite slight pullback.

Copper.note: Structural concentrate deficits and green transition demand outstrip smelter capacity.

Uranium.note: Nuclear renaissance and structural mine supply deficits tighten long-term contract markets.

Lithium.note: Slowing EV growth and new supply from Australia and South America flood the market.

Nickel.note: Indonesian supply growth continues to overwhelm sluggish stainless and battery demand.

Zinc.note: Mine closures tighten supply but galvanized steel demand remains muted by weak property.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese property sector weakness and high port inventories cap upside potential.

Coal.note: Adequate global inventories and renewable energy substitution limit thermal coal price upside.

Rare Earths.note: Chinese export controls and strategic stockpiling provide a floor despite weak EV motor demand.

Manganese.note: Balanced supply from South Africa and Gabon meets steady global steelmaking demand.

PGM.note: Weak auto production and platinum-palladium substitution effects weigh on near-term demand.

Potash.note: Geopolitical supply risks from Russia and Belarus support prices amid steady agricultural demand.

Aluminum.note: Smelter curtailments in China and tight alumina supply support prices despite soft consumer demand.

Diversified.note: Broad portfolio exposure to copper and iron ore provides balanced macro sensitivity.
